Foundation Model

A foundation model is a large, broadly trained model that serves as the base for many applications. Companies build on top of it instead of training their own model from scratch.

Example

A learning app, a translation tool and a coding assistant can all use the same foundation model, just with different prompts or fine-tuning.

Related terms

  • Large Language Model (LLM)
  • Fine-Tuning
  • Open Weights
  • Generative AI
